eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 5:30 PM on AUG 16, 2021 Effective until 5:30 PM AUG 17, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A NEW MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER HAS BEEN ISSUED FOR the west side of Milford Grade south to the County Ln. 

ALL PREVIOUSLY ISSUED WARNINGS AND ORDERS REMAIN IN PLACE
